text: This report seeks additional funding to support the additional costs incurred to date and completion of the remaining construction of the Orangutan Outdoor Exhibit Project.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Adopted the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 30, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 30, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo, remain confidential until the completion of the project, as it pertains to litigation or potential litigation that affects the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo.
